title: Get All Tests Complying Domain And UI
description: Fix all failing tests in the semio monorepo - both domain tests (Python) and UI tests (vitest) - without removing any functionality. Make all tests pass.
summary:
Fixed all failing tests in both domain (Python) and UI (vitest) suites.

**UI fix (elements/ui/index.tsx):** Fixed syntax error at line ~20175 where `};` should have been `});` — the closing parenthesis for `lifecycle.registerCleanup()` callback was missing.

**Domain fix (semio/py/main.py):** Fixed SQLite folder kit roundtrip failure in `_write_kit_to_sqlite`. The function was missing CREATE TABLE and INSERT statements for `folder`, `file`, and `model_tag` tables. Added all three table schemas and their corresponding INSERT logic. The `_read_kit_from_sqlite` function already had read logic for these tables but they were never created/populated during write, causing files and folders to be lost during export-import roundtrip.

Results: 57/57 Python tests pass, 134/134 vitest tests pass.
